decision.explanation: The query '2nd Duke of Newcastle' refers to two distinct historical figures with the same title, as confirmed by the source documents. Document D1 (and card C0) identifies Henry Cavendish, 2nd Duke of Newcastle-upon-Tyne, born in 1630. Document D2 (and card C1) identifies Henry Fiennes Pelham-Clinton, 2nd Duke of Newcastle-under-Lyne, born in 1720. The instruction explicitly states that distinct valid namesakes may coexist and that competing assertions about one referent are not automatically distinct valid answers, but here the referents themselves are distinct individuals holding the same title. Both birth years are directly supported by the text and represent the complete set of valid answers for the ambiguous entity name.
